fuente: Disciplines analyzed by NASA Goddard's Mission Design Lab: propulsion, power, thermal, communications, attitude control and structures.

subsistemas.porque: No engine, no liftoff. LH2/LOX tank leaks must be sealed before repairing it.
Batteries run the computer and valves during ascent, when there are no panels.
Liquid hydrogen boils if it warms up: insulation stops you losing fuel.
Without a link to Earth you won't get the return window. Going past 50% needs the CubeSat relay.
Keeps the rocket pointed correctly. Without it the return trajectory drifts.
A damaged hull can't take the launch loads.
